paragraphs.en: Tip decided to run away. He thought it was unfair to be treated like a statue by Mombi. After waiting for her to fall asleep from her snores, he quietly left his house, grabbed some bread and cheese, and even took the "Powder of Life" pepper-box in case Mombi used it for mischief.
paragraphs.zh: 提普决定逃跑。他认为被蒙比当作雕像对待是不公平的。等她沉睡过去后，他悄悄离开了家，拿了一些面包和奶酪，甚至还顺手带上了“生命之粉”小匣子，以防蒙比用它搞什么鬼名堂。

paragraphs.en: Outside, under the bright moonlight, Tip felt relieved to be leaving. He wondered how he ended up living with Mombi. Realizing Jack Pumpkinhead was left alone with her, Tip returned to the cow-stable and invited Jack to join him.
paragraphs.zh: 外面，在皎洁的月光下，提普感到如释重负，终于可以离开。他不禁思索自己怎么会和蒙比住在一起。意识到杰克南瓜头独自留给了她，提普返回牛棚，请杰克一起走。

paragraphs.en: Jack, standing in the stall by moonlight, smiled as usual. Tip led him out of the stable into the peaceful night.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克在月光下站在马厩里，像往常一样微笑着。提普把他领出马厩，走进宁静的夜色中。

paragraphs.en: Tip led Jack along the path. Jack walked with a limp, his legs occasionally turning backward, almost causing him to stumble. Tip noticed this and began walking more carefully.
paragraphs.zh: 提普领着杰克沿着小径前行。杰克一瘸一拐地走着，双腿偶尔向后扭动，差点绊倒。提普注意到了这一点，开始走得更加小心。

paragraphs.en: They traveled far enough by sunrise that Tip no longer feared pursuit from the witch.
paragraphs.zh: 他们天亮前走了足够远的距离，蒂普不再担心女巫的追捕。

paragraphs.en: Satisfied for now, Tip stopped and sat on a rock. "Let's have some breakfast," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 满意的Tip停了下来，坐在一块岩石上说：“我们先吃点早餐吧。”

paragraphs.en: Jack watched curiously but refused. "I'm not made like you," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克好奇地看了看对方，但还是拒绝了。“我可不是你这个料。”他脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: "I know I made you," replied Tip proudly. "And put you together, carved your eyes, nose, ears, mouth, and dressed you."
paragraphs.zh: “我就是让你有了这一切，”蒂普自豪地回答，“把你拼凑起来，雕刻出你的眼睛、鼻子、耳朵和嘴巴，还给你穿上了衣服。”

paragraphs.en: Jack examined his body critically. "You did a good job," he remarked.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克仔细端详着自己的身体。“你干得不错。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: "Just so-so," admitted Tip modestly. He began to see flaws in his creation. "If we were traveling together, I might have been more careful."
paragraphs.zh: “也就一般般吧，”蒂普谦虚地承认道。他开始察觉到自己作品中存在的不足。“如果我们在一起的话，我可能会更加小心一些。”

paragraphs.en: "Then you must be my creator—my parent—my father!" Jack exclaimed.
paragraphs.zh: “那你一定是我的创造者——我的父母——我的父亲！”杰克脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: Tip laughed and said, "Or your inventor. Yes, my son; I really believe that!"
paragraphs.zh: 提普笑了笑，说道：“或许是你那位发明家。是的，我的儿子；我真的这么认为！”

paragraphs.en: Jack continued, "So I owe you obedience, and you owe me support."
paragraphs.zh: 杰克继续说道：“所以我欠你服从，而你欠我支持。”

paragraphs.en: "That's right," declared Tip, jumping up. "Let's go."
paragraphs.zh: “对，”蒂普跳起来说道，“走吧。”

paragraphs.en: "Where are we going?" asked Jack as they resumed their journey.
paragraphs.zh: “我们要去哪儿？”杰克问道，他们重新启程上路了。

paragraphs.en: "I'm not sure," said the boy. "But we're headed South to the Emerald City."
paragraphs.zh: “我不确定，”男孩说道，“但我们正朝南方前往翡翠城。”

paragraphs.en: "What city is that?" inquired Jack.
paragraphs.zh: “那是哪个城市？”杰克问道。

paragraphs.en: Jack looked around, puzzled. "Is everything here purple?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克环顾四周，疑惑不解地问道：“这里的一切都是紫色的吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Of course," replied the boy. "Look around."
paragraphs.zh: “当然。”男孩回答道，“看看四周。”

paragraphs.en: The Pumpkinhead stared for a moment before saying, "I think I'm color-blind."
paragraphs.zh: 南瓜头愣了片刻，然后说道：“我觉得可能是色盲。”

paragraphs.en: Tip explained, "The grass, trees, houses, and fences are all purple. Even the road mud is purple. But in the Emerald City, everything is green that's purple here.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普解释说：“这里的草、树、房子和篱笆都是紫色的。就连道路上的泥巴也是紫色的。但在翡翠城，这里紫色的东西，在那里都是绿色的。”

paragraphs.en: In the Munchkin Country to the east, it’s blue; in the south, red; and in the west, yellow."
paragraphs.zh: 在东方的麦琪国，天空是蓝色的；向南则是红色；向西则为黄色。

paragraphs.en: Jack said, "Oh!" After a pause, he asked, "Did you say a Tin Woodman rules the Winkies?"
paragraphs.zh: 杰克脱口而出：“哦！”停顿了一下，他问道：“你说统治温基人的是一位铜人木人？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes," replied the boy. "He helped Dorothy defeat the Wicked Witch of the West, and the grateful Winkies invited him to be their ruler."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，”男孩回答，“他帮助多萝西击败了西方恶巫，感激的温基人邀请他做他们的国王。”

paragraphs.en: "Who is the Scarecrow?" Jack inquired.
paragraphs.zh: “ scarecrow 是谁？”杰克问道。

paragraphs.en: "He's another friend of Dorothy’s," explained Tip.
paragraphs.zh: “他又是多丽丝的一个朋友，”蒂普解释道。

paragraphs.en: "And who is Dorothy?" Jack continued.
paragraphs.zh: “那么多萝西是谁？”杰克接着问。

paragraphs.en: "She came from Kansas, a place outside here. She was blown to Oz by a cyclone. The Scarecrow and Tin Woodman traveled with her."
paragraphs.zh: 她来自堪萨斯，一个在这个世界之外的地方。她是被龙卷风吹到了奥兹国。与她同行的还有稻草人和铁皮人。

paragraphs.en: "Where is she now?" asked the Pumpkinhead.
paragraphs.zh: “她现在在哪里？”南瓜头问道。

paragraphs.en: "Glinda sent her back home," said the boy.
paragraphs.zh: “格林达让她回到了家里。”男孩说道。

paragraphs.en: "What about the Scarecrow then?" Jack pressed.
paragraphs.zh: “那稻草人怎么办？”杰克追问。

paragraphs.en: "He rules the Emerald City," answered Tip, seeming exasperated.
paragraphs.zh: “他统治着翡翠城，”提普回答道，显得有些不耐烦。

paragraphs.en: Jack looked confused again. "But you said it was ruled by a Wizard."
paragraphs.zh: 杰克又显得困惑不解。“可是你说它是巫师统治的？”

paragraphs.en: Tip spoke slowly, looking directly into Pumpkinhead's eyes. "Dorothy went to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard for help, and the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman accompanied her. But the Wizard couldn't send Dorothy back home because he wasn't as powerful as he claimed.
paragraphs.zh: 提普缓缓地说，直视着南瓜头的眼睛：“多萝西去了翡翠城请求巫师的帮助，稻草人和铁皮人陪她一起去。但巫师无法将多萝西送回家，因为他没有自己所说的那么强大。”

paragraphs.en: They got angry at him and threatened to expose him. So, the Wizard escaped in a big balloon."
paragraphs.zh: 他们对他怒气冲冲，并威胁要揭发他。于是，巫师乘着一个大热气球逃走了。

paragraphs.en: "That's fascinating," Jack said with satisfaction. "I understand it all except for one part."
paragraphs.zh: “真有趣,”杰克满意地说，“除了一个地方我不太明白。”

paragraphs.en: "Good," Tip replied. "After the Wizard left, the Emerald City made the Scarecrow their king, who became quite popular."
paragraphs.zh: “好极了，”提普应道，“巫师离开后，翡翠城立稻草人国王，他颇受百姓欢迎。”

paragraphs.en: Jack asked curiously, "Are we going to meet this unusual king?"
paragraphs.zh: 杰克好奇地问道：“我们要见这位不寻常的国王吗？”

paragraphs.en: "We might as well," Tip responded. "Unless you have something else in mind."
paragraphs.zh: “那我们不妨就这么办吧，”蒂普应道，“除非你有更好的主意。”

paragraphs.en: Pumpkinhead added, "Of course, dear father. I am happy to go wherever you lead."
paragraphs.zh: 南瓜头补充道：“当然，亲爱的爸爸。我愿意随您前往任何地方。”
